owner_confirmed.scope: 3/6/12 calendar-month anniversaries, preceding valid local session/valuation date ifclosed; canonical availability gates scoring

material_choices.topic: Daily origin, next-day interpretation and availability tolerances
material_choices.recommendation: Use next eligible local session, close+60minute proposed deadline, per-source NAV schedule, explicit bounded FX age; monthly anniversary roll already confirmed FND-DEC-002.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Cutoff/grace/FX freshness change executable timing and leakage; no stale-origin backdate.

material_choices.topic: Target events, thresholds and benchmark mapping
material_choices.recommendation: Keep terminal distributions/up/excess/MDD/MAE/loss separate. Choose risk thresholds by horizon and owner use; approve market/kind total-return benchmark mapping and GBP primary basis.
material_choices.why_owner_material: 5% short/10% long are illustrations only; exact choices define labels and usefulness.

material_choices.recommendation: Approve proposed chronological folds, purging,24month final test, block uncertainty, provisional2%primary-loss hurdle/95%pairedinterval and80%coverage±5pp only after pilot precision evidence.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Caps/thresholds are design proposals, not established performance standards; long horizons may remain unavailable.

material_choices.topic: Bounded models, feature ladder and campaign capacity
material_choices.recommendation: Start R0 then R1/R2, causal20/60MA and20range patterns,20analogs maximum, prospective-only LLM factors when hindsight cannot be bounded. Max2campaigns/month acrossdevprod;96totalfits/campaign and admitted money/resources.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Every extra head/ablation consumes capacity; all horizons retained while qualification is staged.

material_choices.topic: Promotion, probation, safety disable and return authority
material_choices.recommendation: Owner binds each promotion/calibrator/task scope. Separately preapprove deterministic safety pauses; no tuner promotion, live calibration or automatic resume. Define probation maturity/monitoring evidence by task.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Safety disable authority is not acceptance of automatic learning or rollback to ineligible versions.

material_choices.recommendation: Separate nominal/real/FX/contribution/fee/dividend assumptions with3and5year outputs, no invented probabilities.
material_choices.why_owner_material: Scenario outputs are conditional arithmetic, not a long-horizon accuracy promise.

routine_defaults: Immutable typed records, decimal strings, explicit provenance/versions, real-ID synthetic fixtures and no-network specification checks proposed without separate questions.
